section.45: The Book of Oaths (qasamah), Retaliation and Blood Money

45.name_native: The Book of Oaths (qasamah), Retaliation and Blood Money

hadiths.text: Abu Salamah and Sulaiman bin Yasar narrated from one of the Companions of the Messenger of Allah, one of the Ansar, that:the Messenger or Allah approved of Qasamah as it had been during the Jahiliyyah
